params.1273: Catch some shrimp in the fishing spot to the east of Lumbridge Swamp.
params.1274: You can get a small fishing net from the fishing shop in Lumbridge.
params.1275: Follow the road south out of Lumbridge, past Bob's Brilliant Axes and through the graveyard.
params.1276: Keep following the road until you see it fork east to the sea.
params.1277: Click on one of the fishing spots to begin fishing.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
